The existing 33-case RACP client compatibility suite passed at baseline. Neither affects acceptance.
verification: Clean candidate c7f7e277f: 104 tests in eleven files; 101 unique passes including fifteen new RACP ownership cases, zero failures, three existing POSIX process-inspection skips on Windows. Compatibility suites cover RACP client, remote connection, boot, SSH tunnel, pairing, realign, deployment confirmation, prepare and supervisor. limitations: Only the remote RACP client wrapper and its admitted pairing/connect/close/reopen/reconnect paths are accepted. Full remote Host boot ownership, nineteen-family accounting and H1-H5 transfer remain incomplete.
The RACP tests use the in-memory MemoryLink and real RacpClient state machine; no real WebSocket Host, SSH server, stored Host or device token is contacted.
Ownership does not certify native-family closure of Node plugins, Electron utility processes, sockets or browser pages; bounded uncontained-resource evidence stays unqualified.
